title: A small rig. A lot of questions.
author: dachi
summary: The motor-dyno setup gets its own place in the flight log. A fixture, an encoder, and another reason to question the wiring diagram.
mediaAlt: A purple printed motor-dyno fixture with its electronics.
content:
## What this rig is for

The CupExS work includes a separate ESP32 motor-dyno experiment alongside the car controller and finish timer. The firmware reads an MT6701 encoder and an ACS712 current sensor, then estimates torque and power from the configured inertia.

- The car and timer are separate programs.
- A plotted run is evidence to investigate, not a certified motor specification.
- The current dyno pin map has a GPIO21 overlap to reconcile before running the hardware.

```cpp
// Companion dyno source: review the wiring before running.
constexpr int MOTOR_BACKWARD_PIN = 21;
constexpr int MT6701_SDA_PIN = 21;
```

Sometimes the most useful measurement is the one that tells you what to fix next.
